[Unit]
Description=Gantry agent (métricas e arquivos dos labs)

[Service]
ExecStart=%h/.local/bin/gantry-agent
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
# The labs' programs (IOL, QEMU, the cables) started through the agent go
# on running when it restarts or updates.
KillMode=process

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

cd -- "$1" 2>/dev/null || { echo "gantry:nao-e-pasta"; exit 3; }
shift
for f in * .[!.]* ..?*; do if [ -e "$f" ] || [ -L "$f" ]; then set -- "$@" "$f"; fi; done
[ $# -eq 0 ] && exit 0
if command -v stat >/dev/null 2>&1; then stat -c '%F|%s|%Y|%n' -- "$@" 2>/dev/null; exit 0; fi
for f; do if [ -L "$f" ]; then t="symbolic link"; elif [ -d "$f" ]; then t=directory; elif [ -f "$f" ]; then t="regular file"; else t=other; fi; echo "$t|-1|0|$f"; done

tell application (path to frontmost application as text)
set p to
